blocks.text: Preparing for a Same-Day Cleanout Before a Move

c: A small amount of preparation can ensure the same-day storage unit cleanouts service is maximally effective.

items: Secure Access: Ensure you have the correct gate codes, keys, or fobs ready for the crew.
Identify Keepsakes: If there are specific items (e.g., photo albums, documents) you know you want, place them near the front of the unit.
Communicate Constraints: Inform the team of any large, heavy, or potentially valuable items you are aware of.
Notify the Facility: Let the storage company know the cleanout date to ensure smooth access.
